# Milvus

> > Milvus is an open-source, high-performance distributed vector database built for AI applications, supporting RAG, semantic search, and multimodal workloads at scale.

Milvus enables developers to build GenAI applications with vector embeddings, offering deployment options from Milvus Lite to Kubernetes clusters. The platform integrates with PyMilvus SDK, supports hybrid search, and is maintained by Zilliz with extensive documentation and community resources.

## Key Topics

- Vector Database
- Vector Search & Embeddings
- RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
- Semantic Search
- PyMilvus SDK
- Docker & Kubernetes Deployment
- Zilliz Cloud
- Hybrid Search
- Context Engineering
- Multimodal AI
- LLM Integration
- Open Source
- Machine Learning
- AI Applications
